title: Which Federal Reserve policymakers will vote for an interest-rate increase at the July 29, 2026 FOMC meeting?
background: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) sets US monetary policy. Its policy announcements disclose members' votes and the policy preferences of dissenting voters.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The Federal Reserve's official policy statement and voting record for the meeting concluding July 29, 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting. 
  Resolution : Identify every voting member whose recorded position favors increasing the federal funds target range relative to the range immediately before the meeting. Include those members whether an increase is adopted or they dissent in favor of one. 
  Accepted Answer Format : All qualifying members' surnames, listed alphabetically and separated by commas.
